item.description:
<style>
/* Scoped to the SPACE workshop page to avoid altering the rest of the academic site. */
.space26 { --space-blue: #1e3b58; --space-teal: #137c78; --space-muted: #586779; --space-border: #dee6ed; --space-bg: #f5f9fb; line-height: 1.6; }
.space26 .space-eyebrow { color: var(--space-teal); font-size: .84rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .10em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.space26 .space-hero { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--space-border); padding: .45rem 0 1.55rem; margin-bottom: 1.8rem; }
.space26 .space-hero h2 { font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem); font-weight: 750; margin: .25rem 0 .6rem; line-height: 1.16; color: var(--space-blue); }
.space26 .space-subtitle { color: var(--space-muted); margin: 0 0 1rem; font-size: 1.02rem; }
.space26 .space-facts { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .6rem; margin: 1rem 0; }
.space26 .space-facts span { border: 1px solid var(--space-border); border-radius: 99px; padding: .34rem .78rem; background: var(--space-bg); font-size: .88rem; color: var(--space-blue); }
.space26 .space-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .65rem; margin-top: 1.15rem; }
.space26 .space-action { display: inline-block; border-radius: .35rem; padding: .57rem .9rem; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 650; font-size: .9rem; color: white; background: var(--space-blue); }
.space26 .space-action.secondary { color: var(--space-blue); background: white; border: 1px solid var(--space-border); }
.space26 .space-action:hover { text-decoration: none; filter: brightness(1.08); }
.space26 .space-localnav { margin: 1.4rem 0 2rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--space-border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--space-border); padding: .65rem 0; font-size: .91rem; }
.space26 .space-localnav a { margin: 0 .9rem .35rem 0; display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap; }
.space26 h2.space-section { margin: 2.3rem 0 .8rem; padding-bottom: .35rem; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--space-border); color: var(--space-blue); font-weight: 700; }
.space26 h3 { margin-top: 1.4rem; color: var(--space-blue); }
.space26 .space-softnote { border-left: 3px solid var(--space-teal); background: var(--space-bg); padding: .72rem 1rem; margin: 1.2rem 0; font-size: .9rem; }
.space26 .space-table-scroll { overflow-x: auto; margin: .8rem 0 1.7rem; border: 1px solid var(--space-border); border-radius: .35rem; }
.space26 table.space-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-size: .91rem; min-width: 525px; }
.space26 table.space-table thead { background: var(--space-bg); }
.space26 table.space-table td, .space26 table.space-table th { padding: .62rem .75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--space-border); text-align: left; vertical-align: top; }
.space26 table.space-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.space26 table.space-table th { font-weight: 700; color: var(--space-blue); }
.space26 .space-time { width: 105px; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--space-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.space26 .space-speaker { font-weight: 650; color: #1d344d; }
.space26 .space-affiliation { font-size: .79rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--space-muted); margin: .08rem 0 .24rem; }
.space26 .space-paper-title { margin-top: .16rem; }
.space26 .space-special-speaker { margin-top: .45rem; }
.space26 .space-break td { background: #fafcfd; color: var(--space-muted); font-style: italic; }
.space26 .space-special td { background: #eff8f6; }
.space26 .space-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: .8rem; margin: 1rem 0; }
.space26 .space-hotel { padding: .85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--space-border); border-radius: .38rem; background: #fff; }
.space26 .space-hotel h4 { margin: 0 0 .3rem; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--space-blue); }
.space26 .space-hotel p { margin: .2rem 0 .45rem; font-size: .9rem; }
.space26 .space-small { font-size: .88rem; color: var(--space-muted); }
.space26 a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--space-teal); outline-offset: 2px; }
@media (max-width: 570px) { .space26 .space-actions { display: grid; } .space26 .space-action { text-align: center; } .space26 .space-facts span { border-radius: .5rem; } }

.space26 .space-hero-photo { margin: 0 0 1rem; }
.space26 .space-hero-photo img { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 680px; border-radius: .45rem; border: 1px solid var(--space-border); }
.space26 .space-hero-caption { margin: .35rem 0 0; font-size: .8rem; color: var(--space-muted); }
.space26 .space-name-link { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px dotted rgba(19,124,120,.55); }
.space26 .space-name-link:hover { color: var(--space-teal); text-decoration: none; border-bottom-color: var(--space-teal); }
.space26 .space-link-note { margin-top: -.2rem; }
.space26 .space-organizer-list { margin: .5rem 0 1rem 1.1rem; }
.space26 .space-organizer-list li { margin: .3rem 0; }

/* Program color key: distinct, accessible accents for schedule types. */
.space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-talk td { background: #f0f6ff; }
.space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-talk td:first-child { background: #dceafd; border-left: 5px solid #3c76be; color: #214d87; font-weight: 700; }
.space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-ai td { background: #fff0eb; }
.space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-ai td:first-child { background: #f4d5ca; border-left: 5px solid #b65747; color: #80392e; font-weight: 750; }
.space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-poster-session td { background: #e8f7f1; }
.space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-poster-session td:first-child { background: #cfeddf; border-left: 5px solid #198b6e; color: #17634f; font-weight: 750; }
.space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-meal td { background: #fff5df; }
.space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-meal td:first-child { background: #f9e5b9; border-left: 5px solid #d59929; color: #825e1c; font-weight: 700; }
.space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-break td, .space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-admin td { background: #f3f6f9; color: #526577; }
.space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-break td:first-child, .space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-admin td:first-child { border-left: 5px solid #93a1b2; background: #e6ebf1; color: #405366; font-weight: 650; }
.space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-break td { font-style: normal; }
.space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-poster-entry td { background: #f0f9f5; }
.space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-poster-entry td:first-child { border-left: 4px solid #198b6e; }
.space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-talk:hover td { background: #e2eefe; }
.space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-ai:hover td { background: #fbe1d9; }
.space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-poster-entry:hover td, .space26 .space-table tbody tr.space-poster-session:hover td { background: #daf1e6; }

/* People links retain semantic names with surnames emphasized in uppercase. */
.space26 .space-family-name { letter-spacing: .025em; }
/* Sponsor marks: official Economics asset + linked text wordmarks for IAS units. */
.space26 .space-sponsor-intro { margin: .85rem 0 1.15rem; }
.space26 .space-sponsor-intro > p { margin-bottom: .65rem; }
.space26 .space-supporters { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: .6rem; align-items: stretch; }
.space26 .space-supporter { border:1px solid var(--space-border); border-radius:.4rem; min-height: 88px; padding: .75rem .7rem; display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap: .7rem; color:var(--space-blue); background:#fbfcfe; text-decoration:none; font-weight:650; font-size:.80rem; line-height:1.35; }
.space26 .space-supporter:hover { background:#edf5f9; text-decoration:none; }
.space26 .space-supporter img { max-width:100%; width:100%; height:auto; max-height:65px; object-fit:contain; }
.space26 .space-supporter-fallback { display:none; }
.space26 .space-casd-flag { color:#114d76; font-size:1.5rem; font-weight:800; line-height:1; padding-right:.65rem; border-right:1px solid #ccd6de; }
.space26 .space-ias-flag { color:#ae193c; font-size:1.55rem; font-weight:850; line-height:1; padding-right:.65rem; border-right:1px solid #ccd6de; }
.space26 .space-origin-card { border:1px solid #cfdce5; border-left:5px solid; padding:1rem 1.05rem; margin:1.25rem 0; border-radius:.45rem; }
.space26 .space-origin-card h4 { margin:.05rem 0 .7rem; font-size:1.12rem; font-weight:750; }
.space26 .space-origin-airport { border-left-color:#117989; background:#f2fafb; }
.space26 .space-origin-rail { border-left-color:#6057b7; background:#f7f6fd; }
.space26 .space-origin-mtr { border-left-color:#23845a; background:#f5faf6; }
.space26 .space-origin-airport h4 { color:#075e71; }
.space26 .space-origin-rail h4 { color:#5747a0; }
.space26 .space-origin-mtr h4 { color:#1d6d48; }
.space26 .space-origin-card .space-table-scroll { margin-bottom:.1rem; }
.space26 .space-origin-card .space-table td { background: #fff; }
.space26 .space-route-links { margin:.35rem 0 .5rem; font-size:.82rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1.7; }
.space26 .space-map-link { color:#09678b; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:2px; }
.space26 .space-map-link:hover { color:#144669; }
.space26 .space-hotel .space-route-links { margin:.5rem 0 .1rem; }
@media (max-width:700px) { .space26 .space-supporters {grid-template-columns:1fr;} .space26 .space-supporter {min-height:75px; justify-content:flex-start;} .space26 .space-supporter img {max-width:300px;} .space26 .space-origin-card {padding:.65rem .55rem;} }

/* The section menu provides the only Program anchor; the hero now emphasizes registration. */
.space26 .space-hero .space-actions {margin-top:1.15rem;}
.space26 .space-hero-photo img {width:100%;max-width:830px;max-height:370px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 46%;}
.space26 .space-support-caption {font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:750;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--space-teal);margin-bottom:.45rem!important;}
.space26 .space-localnav {display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.3rem .55rem;align-items:center;}
.space26 .space-localnav a {border-radius:.3rem;padding:.32rem .55rem;margin:0; text-decoration:none;}
.space26 .space-localnav a:hover {background:var(--space-bg);text-decoration:none;}

/* Sponsor logos are grouped as Economics and IAS + IAS AI Center. */
.space26 .space-supporters { grid-template-columns: minmax(230px, 1fr) minmax(340px, 1.28fr); gap: .75rem; }
.space26 .space-supporter { background: #fff; border-color: #d3dfec; padding: .7rem .85rem; min-height: 120px; }
.space26 .space-supporter-econ img { max-height: 102px; width: 100%; max-width: 440px; object-fit: contain; }
.space26 .space-ias-logos { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; }
.space26 .space-ias-logos > a { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 0; padding: .15rem; border-radius: .3rem; }
.space26 .space-ias-logos > a:first-child { flex: 0 1 46%; }
.space26 .space-ias-logos > a:last-child { flex: 1 1 54%; }
.space26 .space-ias-logos > a:hover { background: #f1f7fc; }
.space26 .space-ias-logos img { width: 100%; max-height: 92px; object-fit: contain; }
.space26 .space-ias-logos > a:first-child img { max-height: 106px; }
.space26 .space-logo-divider { flex: 0 0 1px; background: #d6dee7; align-self: stretch; max-height: 78px; }
.space26 .space-action-register { background: #123f6a; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #123f6a; font-weight: 750; padding: .7rem 1.1rem; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(18,63,106,.14); }
.space26 .space-action-register:hover { background: #0b3256; }
.space26 .space-past-workshops a { color: #0d6879; font-weight: 600; }
.space26 .space-terminal-note { margin: 1.1rem 0 .15rem; padding: .8rem .95rem; border-left: 4px solid #c48618; background: #fffaf0; border-radius: .35rem; font-size: .9rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #303c49; }
.space26 .space-terminal-note > strong:first-child { display: block; color: #78520c; margin-bottom: .25rem; }
@media (max-width: 750px) {
  .space26 .space-supporters { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .space26 .space-ias-logos { min-height: 90px; }
  .space26 .space-ias-logos > a:first-child { flex: 0 1 46%; }
  .space26 .space-ias-logos > a:last-child { flex: 1 1 54%; }
}


/* v10: Full-content-width hero photo. */
.space26 .space-hero { position: relative; }
.space26 .space-hero-photo img { width: 100%; max-width: none; height: clamp(250px, 45vw, 485px); max-height: none; object-fit: cover; object-position: center 46%; }
.space26 .space-past-workshops-footer { border-top: 1px solid var(--space-border); margin: 1.55rem 0 0; padding-top: .85rem; }

/* Theme controls at the top-right of the header photo. */
.space26 .space-theme-controls { position: absolute; z-index: 3; top: 1rem; right: 1rem; display: flex; gap: .38rem; align-items: center; }
.space26 .space-theme-toggle, .space26 .space-theme-reset { display:inline-flex; gap:.42rem; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height: 37px; border:1px solid #ccd7e2; border-radius:100px; padding:.42rem .72rem; font-size:.83rem; font-weight:700; background:rgba(255,255,255,.96); color:#1b3855; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,20,60,.15); }
.space26 .space-theme-toggle:hover, .space26 .space-theme-reset:hover { background:#e9f3fa; }
.space26 .space-theme-reset[hidden] { display:none!important; }
.space26 .space-theme-toggle:focus-visible, .space26 .space-theme-reset:focus-visible {outline:3px solid #40b1ae;outline-offset:2px;}
.space26 .space-theme-icon { font-size:1.08rem; line-height:1; }

/* Localized arrival instructions apply to taxis only. */
.space26 .space-taxi-instructions { padding: .9rem 1rem; margin:1rem 0 1.3rem; border:1px solid var(--space-border); border-left:5px solid #167d83; border-radius:.45rem; background:var(--space-bg); }
.space26 .space-taxi-instructions h4 {color:var(--space-blue); margin:0 0 .45rem; font-weight:760; font-size:1.04rem;}
.space26 .space-taxi-instructions p { margin:.35rem 0; }
.space26 .space-taxi-zh-label { font-size:.83rem; color:var(--space-muted); font-weight:650; }
.space26 .space-taxi-zh { font-size:1.04rem; letter-spacing:.018em; padding:.65rem .8rem; border:1px solid var(--space-border); border-radius:.35rem; background:var(--space-panel); line-height:1.7; }

/* Page-specific palette; follows system preference unless explicitly overridden. */
.space26 { --space-text:#1c2b3b; --space-panel:#ffffff; --space-link:#0a6884; background:var(--space-panel); color:var(--space-text); color-scheme:light; }
.space26 a:not(.space-action):not(.space-name-link):not(.space-map-link) { color:var(--space-link); }
.space26 .space-sponsor-intro .space-supporter { color:#1e3b58; }
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .space26 .space-hero-photo img {height:250px;}
  .space26 .space-theme-controls { top:.65rem; right:.55rem; }
  .space26 .space-theme-toggle, .space26 .space-theme-reset { font-size:.76rem; padding:.3rem .55rem; min-height:34px; }
}

/* Dark theme (manual override). */

.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] { --space-blue:#d5e6fb; --space-teal:#78d6cb; --space-muted:#aabace; --space-border:#405168; --space-bg:#202f40; --space-text:#e5edf6; --space-panel:#121d2b; --space-link:#83d2f0; color-scheme:dark; }
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-speaker {color:#e4f0ff;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-hero h2, .space26[data-space-theme="dark"] h2.space-section, .space26[data-space-theme="dark"] h3, .space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-hotel h4 { color:#dfedff; }
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-facts span {color:#d7e9fc;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-action-register {background:#215c98; border-color:#397ab5; color:#fff;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-action-register:hover {background:#2f6da8;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-map-link {color:#8fd7ee;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-map-link:hover {color:#bcf1ff;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-past-workshops a {color:#89cfed;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-talk td {background:#1a3048; color:#e0ebf7;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-talk td:first-child {background:#264666; color:#e2f1ff; border-left-color:#84b2f9;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-ai td {background:#3c2929; color:#ffece6;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-ai td:first-child {background:#5a3432; color:#ffd7ca; border-left-color:#e2957c;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-poster-session td, .space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-poster-entry td {background:#183a33; color:#e0f2ea;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-poster-session td:first-child {background:#27584a; color:#e1fff2; border-left-color:#56c7a5;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-poster-entry td:first-child {border-left-color:#56c7a5;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-meal td {background:#3d2f1c; color:#f7e6bf;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-meal td:first-child {background:#57401f; color:#ffe8ae; border-left-color:#e8b75c;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-break td, .space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-admin td {background:#26313f; color:#d0dfec;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-break td:first-child, .space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-admin td:first-child {background:#35465a; color:#dbe8f6; border-left-color:#91a8c2;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-talk:hover td {background:#25405d;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-ai:hover td {background:#513432;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-poster-entry:hover td, .space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-table tbody tr.space-poster-session:hover td {background:#245147;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] table.space-table thead {background:#27394c;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-origin-airport {background:#18313a; border-color:#3d6371; border-left-color:#4bb0c1;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-origin-rail {background:#27263e; border-color:#494769; border-left-color:#9c8fe5;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-origin-mtr {background:#1d332d; border-color:#436354; border-left-color:#72c6a1;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-origin-airport h4 {color:#93dfec;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-origin-rail h4 {color:#c9bbfa;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-origin-mtr h4 {color:#9ce7c5;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-origin-card .space-table td {background:#1b293a; color:#dce8f7;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-softnote, .space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-taxi-instructions {background:#1d303b; color:#e1eef1;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-taxi-zh {background:#172632; color:#e6f3ff;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-terminal-note {background:#392f20; color:#f1e3c8; border-left-color:#d8a64b;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-terminal-note > strong:first-child {color:#ffe2a0;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-hotel {background:#192839;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-supporter, .space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-sponsor-intro .space-supporter {background:#fff; color:#1e3b58;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-supporter:hover {background:#eef7fb;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-ias-logos > a:hover {background:#ebf4fc;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-name-link {border-bottom-color:#76cfc7;}
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-theme-toggle, .space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-theme-reset { background:rgba(17,34,53,.96); color:#ebf5ff; border-color:#7894ad; }
.space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-theme-toggle:hover, .space26[data-space-theme="dark"] .space-theme-reset:hover {background:#254561;}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {

.space26:not([data-space-theme]) { --space-blue:#d5e6fb; --space-teal:#78d6cb; --space-muted:#aabace; --space-border:#405168; --space-bg:#202f40; --space-text:#e5edf6; --space-panel:#121d2b; --space-link:#83d2f0; color-scheme:dark; }
.space26:not([data-space-theme]) .space-speaker {color:#e4f0ff;}
.space26:not([data-space-theme]) .space-hero h2, .space26:not([data-space-theme]) h2.space-section, .space26:not([data-space-theme]) h3, .space26:not([data-space-theme]) .space-hotel h4 { color:#dfedff; }
.space26:not([data-space-theme]) .space-facts span {color:#d7e9fc;}
.space26:not([data-space-theme]) .space-action-register {background:#215c98; border-color:#397ab5; color:#fff;}
.space26:not([data-space-theme]) .space-action-register:hover {background:#2f6da8;}
.space26:not([data-space-theme]) .space-map-link {color:#8fd7ee;}
.space26:not([data-space-theme]) .space-map-link:hover {color:#bcf1ff;}
.space26:not([data-space-theme]) .space-past-workshops a {color:#89cfed;}
.space26:not([data-space-theme]) .space-table tbody tr.space-talk td {background:#1a3048; color:#e0ebf7;}
.space26:not([data-space-theme]) .space-table tbody tr.space-talk td:first-child {background:#264666; color:#e2f1ff; border-left-color:#84b2f9;}
.space26:not([data-space-theme]) .space-table tbody tr.space-ai td {background:#3c2929; color:#ffece6;}

(function () {
  function initSpaceTheme(root) {
    var toggle = root.querySelector('.space-theme-toggle');
    var icon = root.querySelector('.space-theme-icon');
    if (!toggle || !icon) return;
    var device = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') : null;
    // Follow the device by default; manual override lasts for the current page visit.
    function effectiveTheme() {
      return root.getAttribute('data-space-theme') || (device && device.matches ? 'dark' : 'light');
    }
    function updateControl() {
      var dark = effectiveTheme() === 'dark';
      icon.textContent = dark ? '☀' : '☾';
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', dark ? 'Switch to light mode' : 'Switch to dark mode');
      toggle.setAttribute('title', dark ? 'Switch to light mode' : 'Switch to dark mode');
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', root.hasAttribute('data-space-theme') ? 'true' : 'false');
    }
    toggle.addEventListener('click', function () {
      root.setAttribute('data-space-theme', effectiveTheme() === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark');
      updateControl();
    });
    if (device) {
      if (device.addEventListener) device.addEventListener('change', updateControl);
      else if (device.addListener) device.addListener(updateControl);
    }
    updateControl();
  }
  function start() { document.querySelectorAll('.space26').forEach(initSpaceTheme); }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
  else start();
})();
</script>
<script>
(function () {
  function revealSpaceTarget(id) {
    if (!id) return;
    var target = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!target) return;
    var node = target;
    var toOpen = [];
    while (node && node !== document.body) {
      if (node.tagName && node.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'details' && node.classList.contains('space-fold')) toOpen.push(node);
      node = node.parentElement;
    }
    toOpen.reverse().forEach(function (detail) { detail.open = true; });
    // Internal links can point directly at closed travel subsections, too.
    if (target.tagName && target.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'section') {
      var sectionFold = target.querySelector(':scope > details.space-main-fold');
      if (sectionFold) sectionFold.open = true;
    }
  }
  function startSpaceFolds() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.space26 a[href^="#"]').forEach(function (a) {
      a.addEventListener('click', function () { revealSpaceTarget(decodeURIComponent(a.getAttribute('href').slice(1))); });
    });
    revealSpaceTarget(decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1)));
    var navLinks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.space26 .space-localnav a[href^="#"]'));
    function updateNav(target) {
      navLinks.forEach(function (link) {
        if (link.getAttribute('href') === '#' + target) link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'location');
        else link.removeAttribute('aria-current');
      });
    }
    navLinks.forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function () { updateNav(link.getAttribute('href').slice(1)); });
    });
    if (location.hash) updateNav(decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1)));
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', startSpaceFolds);
  else startSpaceFolds();
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', function () { revealSpaceTarget(decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1))); });
})();
</script>
<script>
(function () {
  function initTaxiAudio() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.space26 .space-taxi-speak').forEach(function (button) {
      var panel = button.closest('.space-taxi-instructions');
      var status = panel && panel.querySelector('.space-taxi-speech-status');
      var label = button.querySelector('span');
      if (!panel || !status || !label) return;
      if (!('speechSynthesis' in window) || !('SpeechSynthesisUtterance' in window)) {
        button.disabled = true;
        status.textContent = 'Voice playback is unavailable in this browser; please show the address above.';
        return;
      }
      var synth = window.speechSynthesis;
      function reset() { label.textContent = 'Play Cantonese'; button.removeAttribute('aria-pressed'); }
      function cantoneseVoice() {
        var voices = synth.getVoices();
        return voices.find(function (v) { return /^yue(?:[-_]|$)/i.test(v.lang); }) ||
          voices.find(function (v) { return /^zh[-_]HK(?:[-_]|$)/i.test(v.lang); }) ||
          voices.find(function (v) { return /cantonese|廣東話|粵語|粤语/i.test(v.name); });
      }
      button.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (synth.speaking || synth.pending) synth.cancel();
        var voice = cantoneseVoice();
        var voiceList = synth.getVoices();
        if (!voice && voiceList.length) {
          reset();
          status.textContent = 'No Cantonese voice is available on this device. Please show the written address to the driver.';
          return;
        }
        // Cantonese-only playback; the on-screen address retains IAS building details.
        var utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance('唔該，去香港科技大學嘅賽馬會高等研究院，西貢清水灣道。');
        utterance.lang = voice ? voice.lang : 'zh-HK';
        if (voice) utterance.voice = voice;
        utterance.rate = .88;
        utterance.onstart = function () {
          label.textContent = 'Playing…'; button.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');
          status.textContent = voice ? '' : 'Using the device voice; Cantonese pronunciation may vary.';
        };
        utterance.onend = reset;
        utterance.onerror = function () {
          synth.cancel();
          reset();
          status.textContent = 'Playback failed. Please show the written address to the driver.';
        };
        try { synth.speak(utterance); }
        catch (err) { synth.cancel(); reset(); status.textContent = 'Playback unavailable. Please show the written address to the driver.'; }
      });
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initTaxiAudio);
  else initTaxiAudio();
})();
</script>
